blind.why: Main menu at 1280 (real first-run, no ?test) vs the CS2 Play tab. Ours has the clearer path to a match: one PLAY call to action, match setup panel and a lit line-up. It still shows a stray red/blue vertical bar at top centre (x~620-660, y 0-150), a noisy mirror reflection, and the setup panel overlaps the ring. CS2 stages a single crisp hero better.

Video settings at 1920 vs CS2 Advanced Video. CS2 is dense and useful, with a live preview, tooltips and recommended values. Our Video tab has only 5 options, yet the last row (Colour-blind) still sits under the fade mask with a MORE cue. Quality-card descriptions are about 9px, and there is no preview of what a setting does.

Real match-end recap after a full 13-round bot match vs the CS2 Victory scoreboard. Ours has clean tables, award cards, a credit graph and a round strip, and reads better than CS2's translucent board with chat noise. However, its round strip shows 4 orange Ember chips under an Ember score of 5, so the data contradicts itself.

biggest_gap: LEAVE MATCH IS IMPOSSIBLE. In pause, Leave match opens the 'Leave match?' confirm. confirmLeave() appends the box INSIDE pause.el and then sets pause.el.inert=true, and box.inert=false cannot un-inert a descendant of an inert parent. Stay and Leave are therefore dead: elementFromPoint at the Leave button returns the <canvas>, a real mouse click does nothing, Tab+Enter does nothing, and focus falls to <body>. The game stays paused under a dimmed, dead dialog. I watched it for 205 s; the only way out is Esc, which resumes the match. Repro: shots/critic-menu-r3/leaveprobe.mjs (?test=1&menu=1, then debug.play, openPause, click Leave match, click Leave → base stays 'pause'), and the real flow in c02-c04 (flow3.mjs). CS2's disconnect confirm is a top-level modal that works by mouse and keyboard. Fix: mount the confirm as a sibling overlay (not a child of pause.el) or inert only the pause card, focus Stay, and let Esc mean Stay.
other_gaps: Viewmodel & HUD tab at 1920x1080 (g_settings-viewmodel_1920.png, crop_vm.png): the 'Schematic preview…' note is squeezed into a column about one word wide that overflows and clips at the sheet edge ('Schemat', 'placeme'), and the offset value readouts are clipped ('0.0C'). The preview itself is a flat tan plane with a blocky gun.

Pause keyboard focus: in the real flow (Esc in game) focus lands on the Sensitivity range input, not on 'Click to resume' (logged outerHTML in log3_1280.txt; slider ring visible in d03_pause_1280.png). Arrow Left/Right then silently change sensitivity. Opening Settings from the main menu leaves focus on <body> until Tab is pressed. The Leave confirm also never takes focus.

F1 while paused never opens the cheat-sheet (3 of 3 runs; F1 in game works, d02). Once, after Esc, ArrowDown x2, F1, the 3D view behind the pause card switched to the MENU showcase and the 'GET MOVING' tutorial card reappeared beside the pause card (c01_f1_pause_1280.png).

Recap round strip vs score: in the real match the strip shows 4 orange and 9 cyan chips while the header reads Ember 5 – 8 Tide (m_recap_1280.png). Chips seem to be coloured by side-winner after the halftime swap, not by team, and there is no halftime divider in the strip.

The first-run tutorial card ('GET MOVING 1/4') stays up through the entire match if the player doesn't complete the step; it was still there at round 5 (m_round5_1280.png). CS2-style onboarding should time out or collapse after the first live round.

Recap: about 90px of dead band between the timeline panel and the buttons at 1280. The local player's row is not highlighted unless they are MVP. 'TIDE WINS THE MATCH' is low-contrast over the sky backdrop.
